The '''''Vehement Sword''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military vessel that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Vehement" /> The ''Sword'' was equipped with the experimental [[Null Cannon]]s<ref name="Arms Race" /> as part of a massive [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was preparing for an invasion of the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but the fleet was ambushed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The ship survived for several days until the battle reached the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="Gnost" /> when it was among those warships that crashed to the surface during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]], and it broke in two when it landed in the region later known as the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]].<ref name="Vehement" />
